g.text: ALM state lifecycle — observed attempt and reviewed evaluation
Each CLI command loads the pinned ALM contract and trusted JSON policy,
then opens the versioned SQLite store. --subject identifies a local operator;
the CLI does not authenticate a remote user.
read exact PolicySet revision, if already stored
propose: candidates are not active state
validate candidate envelopes against pinned contract
decide: human review is a separate write
read target and exact candidate set
display target and candidates; request CONFERMO
require decide grant and applicable human role;
recompute hash against latest target and candidates
new target revision with decision link/status
apply: approval alone does not change the context
require apply grant; resolve latest proposal
ResourceBinding / Evaluation; create new context revision
new context, APPLIED proposal, expected_version, OP)
write immutable rows, context pointer, operation receipt
